target: Isolated sandboxed macOS fixture using Magpie’s production settings, launcher, protocol and transport with one synthetic clip

scenarios.observed: Connect to Claude opened the install dialog. The approved extension discovered two tools. A fresh desktop session searched for and read the synthetic clip and returned the matching proof from beyond the preview. A second session used the tool and returned zero results after revocation.
A fresh ephemeral session used the final QA build through the actual Claude-installed launcher. Both tool calls succeeded and the tool result and answer contained the expected proof.
The corrected package initialized and returned the exact proof from the full clip. After revocation, search was empty. An inherited-stdio negative control failed on initialize.

resolved_failures: The original installer opened correctly, but Claude timed out on initialize until the launcher forwarded the host's JavaScript streams explicitly.
The launcher then reached Claude's modern tool discovery. Claude rejected tools/list until Magpie included the required cache fields for modern discovery and tool listing.
